hero.subtitle: Reliable heat-pump solutions for swimming pools, industrial basins, domestic hot water and residential buildings.

about.title: About IRIS Energy
about.p1: IRIS Energy is a French company and registered brand established in 2011. Its target markets cover Europe and Mediterranean countries, with products serving customers across Europe, Africa and the Middle East.
about.p2: IRIS Energy has operated in the Egyptian market since 2020 through cooperation with AOI-ABD. This local presence combines product expertise with engineering support for project studies, installation, maintenance and long-term service.
about.p3: We accompany clients from early project stages through system selection, technical studies, installation and ongoing support. Our objective is to propose a solution that balances performance, budget, energy efficiency and service quality.

values.meaning: Recommendations begin with project requirements and operating conditions.
Components and system configurations are selected for dependable operation.
Heat-pump technology is applied to reduce unnecessary energy use.
Installation, maintenance and spare-parts follow-up are part of the project lifecycle.
